description: Quadra, a global award-winning partner, architects the Intelligent Enterprise for the world's leading businesses. We transform complex Cloud & AI innovation into a competitive advantage, built on 25 years of deep, vendor-agnostic architectural expertise.

blocks.text: Architect a Well-Governed Cloud Landing Zone

We use AWS Control Tower to architect and build a secure, compliant, and well-architected multi-account AWS environment. We provide the fastest and most effective way to establish a governed foundation, or "landing zone," for your enterprise.
Without a Blueprint, Your Cloud Will Sprawl into Chaos

As your organization scales on AWS, managing multiple accounts can quickly become a major challenge. Leaders are asking: "How do we ensure every new account is created with our security and compliance standards built-in? How do we centrally manage policies across our entire organization? How do we avoid the chaos of an ungoverned cloud?"

blocks.alt: a group of people sitting around a wooden table
Two people sitting across from each other in an office working on a Surface laptop

blocks.text: The Blueprint for a Secure and Scalable Landing Zone

Our approach is to architect a governed foundation from day one. We use AWS Control Tower to automate the setup of a best-practice landing zone. Our blueprint includes a centralized management account, a dedicated log archive, an audit account with security guardrails, and an automated "Account Factory" to ensure that every new account you provision is secure, compliant, and ready for your workloads.
Architecting a secure, multi-account environment using Control Tower best practices.
